protocol_sections: section 10 (Gate 2), section 5.5 (simulated scalp), section 8 (inscription), Annex B (this file)
note: Spec machine du G5 Gate 2 (prospectif, confirmation). Gele EN MEME TEMPS que le spec Gate 1 (piege 7) : memes types, classifieur, seuils, signes, fenetres, controles, unite et criteres ; seules changent la source (capture), l'execution (simulee sur carnet reel, lp_sim) et les calendriers (2026-11 -> 2027-04). Chaque cle doit etre implementee (requires) ; toute cle inconnue est refusee ; toute valeur null ou owner_decision_pending interdit le statut FROZEN. Le sha256 de la version FROZEN fait partie du gel (protocole section 13). Revision 0.1.2-draft (2026-10-21, passe de correction apres tradingV3-private/research/20261020T2321Z-g5-periods/review-b/quant.md) : textes libres seulement, chaque texte lie au lecteur strict est inchange. Les reponses du proprietaire D7 (P-G5-10 (i) : option a ; (ii) : refus lu dans Nn, remplace par D10 du 2026-10-21 : les deux sources, choix sur la qualite, recopie dans classifier_index_source) et D8 (piste S close, P-S3 sans objet, BTC et ETH restent) sont ecrites dans les textes et au journal du registre ; elles sont recopiees dans les blocs de decision au gel (status et choice restent owner_decision_pending jusque-la : echec ferme). Revision 0.1.5-draft (2026-10-21, passe avant gel) : D7 (i) et D8 sont ecrites dans leurs blocs avant le gel (events[T05_us_open].window_end = a_end_2027_03_31, universe.p_s3_track_s = moot_track_s_closed, valeur ajoutee au lecteur ; owner_decided ; decision_ref_p_g5_10_i, decision_ref_p_g5_10_ii et decision_ref_p_s3 de freeze_fill = textes dates du proprietaire) : plus aucune valeur owner_decision_pending ; T05 au Gate 2 est G5_GATE2_NOT_INFORMATIVE par construction, ecrit par le lecteur (audit power_by_construction, raison power_floor_unreachable_by_construction) ; le fetcher de l option b existe (g5_index_fetch), le lecteur admet D10 en FROZEN. Une valeur qui contient le marqueur freeze_pending suivi d un deux-points marque un choix de redaction que le corps du protocole ne fixe pas encore (a1, sections 10 et 11) ; elle interdit FROZEN (regle codee le 2026-10-22, g5_eval.refuse_freeze_pending). Avant le gel, le canal funding-rate n est verifie que sur la documentation et sur un echantillon de schema (noms de champs, valeurs de settState, fundingTime contre ts ; aucun taux affiche ni persiste hors de la tape ; GATES 9.5) ; le texte FROZEN de costs.funding.source est g5_gate2.FUNDING_SOURCE. Revision 0.1.3-draft (2026-10-21, amendement A1 du Gate 1, avant tout gel et toute lecture) : events[T01_funding_8h].adverse_selection_entry_leg = measured_by_fill_proxy, identique au Gate 1 (piege 7, verifie par check_gate1_identity) ; il ne regle que la construction descriptive du Gate 1 sur les derniers prints (9,5 pb au lieu de 13) ; la mesure primaire simulee mesure tous ses termes et n est pas touchee. Revision 0.1.6-draft (2026-10-22, decisions du proprietaire de ce jour, avant tout gel et toute lecture) : (a) "Finir les controles G5 realisables des maintenant" : test de contenu des calendriers (content_rule, nyse_half_days, content_exceptions), refus de FROZEN sur le marqueur, S_eco = 97,25 aux deux portes (D4), le Gate 1 lit ce fichier avant toute donnee (gate2_frozen_together) ; (b) "Choisir la traversee comme remplissage principal du Gate 2, et garder le simple contact comme comparaison descriptive" : execution_sim.entry_fill_rule = through, touch et queue descriptives (fill_rules_touch_and_queue), jamais decisives : le resultat touch ne peut jamais sauver un FAIL, un NOT_INFORMATIVE ou un INCONCLUSIVE. Les huit marqueurs restent dans ce brouillon : le FROZEN est refuse tant qu ils ne sont pas ecrits au corps du protocole ou retires (a1).

frozen_with.rule: both specs are frozen in the same freeze line (protocol section 13 point 5) ; Gate 1 side (capability gate2_frozen_together of g5_gate1_spec.json, protocol (B) xxiv, implemented 2026-10-22 under the owner decision (a) of that day: g5_gate2.check_frozen_together, g5_eval.command_eval, option --gate2-spec): before any market read the Gate 1 evaluator reads this file and refuses to run unless it is FROZEN, holds no owner_decision_pending, no freeze_pending marker and no null, and its freeze_fill.gate1_spec_sha256 equals the sha256 of the Gate 1 spec read ; the sha256 of this file is printed in the Gate 1 output and written in the register the day of the Gate 1 run ; Gate 2 side (g5_gate2): a FROZEN Gate 2 is refused unless its Gate 1 is FROZEN with that sha256 (review-b quant B1, CTO M2) ; the former clause on a Gate 2 frozen after a Gate 1 reading is withdrawn (no spec carries a freeze timestamp: not checkable)

quarantine_rule: nothing timestamped in [end_exclusive_utc ; quarantine_floor_utc) is ever read ; the Gate 2 reads capture rows with ts >= quarantine_floor_utc only (xperp_capture.QUARANTINE_FLOOR and g5_fetch.END_EXCLUSIVE, module constants, checked for equality)

window.end_rule: GATES 1.3 (end of scoring <= 2027-03-31) and D1 (capture until 2027-03-31 at the latest) ; per type: events[].window_end ; T05 per owner decision P-G5-10 (i): answer D7 (2026-10-21) = option a, end 2027-03-31, written in events[T05_us_open].window_end since 0.1.5-draft ; data-gap extension as implemented (g5_eval, g5_gate2.extended_end ; review-b quant m3): a lost day is a UTC day on which every eligible instrument is unusable (quality.unusable_instrument_day), the extension adds calendar days (a weekend day added brings no NYSE day to T05), at most max_days, and goes beyond 2027-03-31 only under the decisions of the chosen option, dated before the freeze ; under D7 no extension is possible (both type windows end on 2027-03-31): unusable days are counted, never replaced

price.series: capture trades layout: price of the last print with ts in (t - 60 s ; t]
price.boundary_convention: c(t) = last print of the minute ending at t (Gate 1: close of the 1m candle opening at t - 60 s)

frozen_candle.gate1_equivalent: vol = 0 on a key candle (a minute without any print is the capture analogue of a frozen candle)

unit.n_definition: number of unique event instants with >= min_instruments_per_instant retained instruments

statistics.measure_definition: simulated round trip on the captured book (execution_sim): entry, passive exit then taker remainder, fees at the role, slippage on taker legs, funding of the settlements crossed ; adverse selection and spread paid are inside the simulated prices ; the Gate 1 construction (descriptive net_bp_gate1_construction_on_last_prints) is printed next to the primary (review-b quant m8: same sign and return windows as the Gate 1 ; the simulated exit to h+60 or h+75 is a frozen execution rule, protocol 5.5 ; printing to code, a2)
descriptive_measures: net_bp (Gate 1 construction on last prints with the Gate 1 design costs)
statistics.difference: D = mean over event instants - mean over control instants

costs.adverse_selection: measured_in_simulation (lp_sim fills on the real book ; protocol 10.2) ; no assumed term in sim_net_bp
costs.taker_half_spread: measured_in_simulation (taker legs at the opposite touch)
costs.stress_rule: fees and slippage x 1.5 ; the measured terms are inside the simulated prices and cannot be multiplied there, so the stressed net also subtracts 0.5 x the Gate 1 design value of each measured term: 1.75 bp per filled maker leg (adverse selection 3.5 bp) and 1.5 bp per taker entry (half spread 3 bp)
costs.stress_rule_status: freeze_pending: proposed by this draft, to be written in protocol 10.2 by a1 (review-b quant M5 ; protocol 10.2 is silent on stressing measured terms) ; implemented by g5_eval measure_lp_sim and the g5_gate2 add-on ; never weaker than the Gate 1 stress on the assumed terms ; declared gap (review-b quant m9, calcul d'audit): T01 stress adds 5.5 bp at Gate 2 (fees 4 to 6 bp, no taker leg, 2 x 1.75 bp) against 6.5 bp at Gate 1 (13 to 19.5 bp), because the 2 bp design slippage of a maker/maker round trip disappears when both legs are maker ; T05 adds 7.75 bp at both gates

design_values_gate1.use: descriptive net_bp and stress add-on only

costs.g2_table_substitution: none: the Gate 2 measures its own adverse selection (protocol 10.2)

funding.source: capture funding-rate channel: settled rate of each settlement (settFundingRate with settState settled, attributed to fundingTime) ; field semantics UNKNOWN, to verify on the documentation and the first capture before freeze
funding.fallback: GATES 5.1: REST public/funding-rate-history read after T0 only ; freeze_pending: not implemented (g5_fetch persists nothing at or after END_EXCLUSIVE) and not covered by D1 (a new reading decision) ; the FROZEN text starts with none (an unknown settled rate excludes the observation, unknown_rate)
funding.formula: funding_bp = -side * sum(settled rates of the instrument's settlements T with first_fill - execution_sim.funding_fill_grace_min < T <= exit) * 1e4

execution_sim.entry_fill_rule_decision: owner decision (b), 2026-10-22: "Choisir la traversee comme remplissage principal du Gate 2, et garder le simple contact comme comparaison descriptive" ; primary fill rule through (a resting order fills on a print strictly through its price or on an opposite touch crossing it: the pessimistic bound, as the Gate 1 proxy) ; touch (head of the queue, the optimistic bound) and queue reported in fill_rules_touch_and_queue, never decisive: the touch result can never rescue a FAIL, a NOT_INFORMATIVE or an INCONCLUSIVE (protocol 10.2, 11.1)
execution_sim.stale_rule: book older than stale_s at the decision: intention not placed, counted (as G2 section 5)
execution_sim.post_only: an order that would cross the opposite touch at activation is cancelled and counted (crossed)
execution_sim.funding_fill_grace_rule: a fill within 1 min after a settlement crosses it and pays (the actual fee assessment may take up to a minute ; protocol 5.1 and (B) xxi)
execution_sim.size: lp_sim.InstrumentSpec.size_for_notional with ct_val, lot_sz, min_sz of the freeze snapshot ; size 0 = skipped_size, counted
execution_sim.rpi_bias: declared bias to PASS while trades.source is not captured (G2 0.9)

selection_rule.decision_ref: D10 (2026-10-21), LP-OWNER-DECISIONS-2026-10-21.md : On essaye des deux un par un puis on decide ; rule written before the capture and never revised after a reading of T01
selection_rule.status: decided by the owner (D10) ; computed by g5_gate2.select_index_source, checked by g5_gate2.verify_index_selection and g5_eval.run_study
selection_rule.window_minutes: every minute boundary g with T0 <= g < end_exclusive of T01_funding_8h (before any data-gap extension), for every distinct index_id of universe.analysed
selection_rule.coverage: share of the (index_id, g) pairs of window_minutes with an idx_minute from a_capture_index_tickers
selection_rule.agreement: median, over the (index_id, g) pairs of window_minutes where both sources have an idx_minute, of |idx_a(g) - idx_b(g)| / idx_b(g) x 1e4 (bp)

selection_rule.forbidden: comparing the T01 results obtained with each source in order to choose

calendars.covers_rule: the evaluator refuses a spec whose scoring window (every events[].window_end and the data gap extension included) is not inside covers, and a FROZEN spec whose lists are not complete over covers: a NYSE holiday or a CPI / Employment Situation / FOMC date missing from a list would be scored as an ordinary day ; the window coverage is implemented (g5_gate2, calendars_cover_the_window) ; the content test is implemented since 2026-10-22 (owner decision (a) of that day ; review-b quant M4 ; capability calendars_content_test_at_freeze, g5_eval.calendar_content, the rule of content_rule, the same test on the Gate 1 spec over its own window): a FROZEN spec has at least one CPI date and one Employment Situation date per calendar month of [T0 ; last scored day + data-gap extension], except dated and sourced exceptions written here (postponement, government shutdown), at least one FOMC statement date per 8-week span, NYSE holidays equal to a rule-based generator (New Year, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Washington's Birthday, Good Friday from Easter, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving = 4th Thursday of November, Christmas, observed-day rules ; every exception written) and the NYSE half days listed (a 13:00 ET close moves the us_cash_close exclusion)
calendars.content_rule: FROZEN only, over R = [T0 ; last scored day + data-gap extension] (Gate 1: the spec window) ; at least one cpi date and one employment_situation date in every calendar month that meets R, unless content_exceptions names that list and that month ; every span of 56 consecutive days inside R holds a fomc_statement date ; the nyse_holidays inside R equal the rule-based NYSE generator (New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day = 3rd Monday of January, Washington's Birthday = 3rd Monday of February, Good Friday from Easter, Memorial Day = last Monday of May, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day = 1st Monday of September, Thanksgiving = 4th Thursday of November, Christmas Day ; a Saturday holiday observed the Friday before except New Year's Day, a Sunday holiday the Monday after) up to the dates content_exceptions adds (extra_closure) or removes (not_observed) ; nyse_half_days listed (each a NYSE trading day ; the sessions with on_nyse_half_days take that time on them, a 13:00 ET close moves the us_cash_close exclusion) ; every exception dated (written_utc) and sourced
